gpt-6-astra.description: Strongest reasoning for demanding end-to-end work: architecture, intricate concurrency and security analysis, ambiguous cross-system problems.

gpt-6-sol.description: New-generation general and complex coding and agentic workflows, with improved factual reliability and communication relative to GPT-5.6 Sol.

gpt-6-luna.description: New-generation focused, repeatable coding, extraction, transformation and summaries with clear acceptance criteria.

gpt-5.6-sol.description: Earlier-generation flagship for complex coding, research and agent workflows; retain for established compatible tasks or demonstrated cost/quality advantage.

gpt-5.6-terra.description: Earlier-generation balanced model for routine work and bounded multi-step coding; suitable when tasks need more judgment than focused extraction.

gpt-5.6-luna.description: Earlier-generation model for focused, cost-sensitive high-volume tasks. Cost advantage must be established from supplied prices, not assumed.

gpt-5.5.description: Legacy general-purpose reasoning and coding model; useful for workflows evaluated on GPT-5.5 or when the supplied policy/context favors that model. Do not invent a price or performance advantage.
